The brief

“A single-family home remodel that balances traditional elegance for the owners with modern bedrooms for their children.

Two characters share one address. The family rooms keep a classic, quiet palette – paneled cabinetry, warm oak, travertine and soft plaster – while each child’s room gets a personality of its own.

Every space was planned and detailed by AT Studio as part of one remodel, so the home reads as a whole from the kitchen to the last bedroom.

Crafting practical and exquisitely designed environments for truly transformative spaces.

  1. IThe KitchenTraditional elegance
  2. IIPrimary BathCalm and light
  3. IIIGarden BedroomFor the children
  4. IVCity BedroomFor the children
I

For the owners

The Kitchen

Cream paneled cabinetry, an oak island and a travertine floor – a classic kitchen with a warm, lived-in calm and seating for the whole family.

II

For the owners

Primary Bath

A floating walnut vanity, ornamental plaster, an arched window and a freestanding tub under a crystal chandelier.

Soft stone, warm wood and a touch of gold – details chosen to feel timeless rather than trendy.

Plaster · Stone · Walnut · Brass

For the children

Two bedrooms, two personalities – each designed around the child who lives there.

III

For the children

Garden Bedroom

A botanical mural, soft lilac textiles and a built-in desk by the window – a room that can grow with its owner.

Built-ins keep the floor free for play, while the mural turns the walls into a garden.

IV

For the children

City Bedroom

A graphic black-and-white city mural, grey upholstery, track lighting and a long desk wall with display shelving.
